Rework the userprompt to split into command words.
Tasks can be marked or unmarked by specifying its index.

I am using multiple ArrayLists for attributes instead of a
custom datatype because I thought I would need to pass in
the item String and use ArrayList.indexOf() to fetch the
index. Turns out I read the requirements wrong.
